# Logistics Plus Inc.

Logistics Plus Inc. is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Logistics Plus is a leading worldwide provider of transportation, warehousing, fulfillment, global logistics, and supply chain solutions. Logistics Plus Inc. employs 1,338 people (+9.8% YoY, +119 people) and has an annual revenue of $400M, founded in 1996. Headquartered in Erie, Pennsylvania, United States, with offices including Leavenworth, Vancouver, Brea, Coppell, and Dayton. Its workforce is distributed across 46 countries (including United States, India, Brazil, Ukraine, and Mexico).

## About

Logistics Plus, Inc. is a unique global supply chain solutions company built for what’s next. With nearly $1 billion in annual revenue and operations spanning 55+ countries, Logistics Plus® delivers transportation, warehousing, fulfillment, project management, and technology solutions for businesses navigating a complex, ever-changing world. Privately held and people-driven, the company’s nearly 2,000 employees bring its trademark Passion for Excellence™ to every customer relationship and every challenge. Logistics Plus is a 21st Century Logistics Company™ recognized as a Great Place to Work® and a top global logistics and technology provider.

# LoadDelivered Logistics

LoadDelivered Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. LoadDelivered Logistics provides supply chain management solutions for various industries, including importer of record services, global sourcing and procurement, global control towers, managed transportation, linguistic solutions, technology solutions, business intelligence, risk-free supply chain analysis, and transportation management. LoadDelivered Logistics employs 84 people (+75.0% YoY, +36 people) and has an annual revenue of $165.6M, founded in 2008. Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Colombia, and Malaysia.

## About

LoadDelivered Logistics is a Chicago freight brokerage. We were founded in 2008 and joined Logistics Plus, a global logistics company, in 2025.

We move truckload, LTL, flatbed and heavy haul, and refrigerated freight across North America. Through Logistics Plus, our customers also reach air and ocean freight, warehousing, and customs brokerage, which means one team can handle a shipper's entire network rather than one lane of it.

Recognized by Transport Topics as a Top Freight Brokerage Firm by net revenue, by Food Logistics as a Top 3PL & Cold Storage Provider and a Top Software & Technology Provider, and named WK Kellogg's Broker of the Year. Based at 640 N LaSalle in River North. Small enough that a pricing decision is a conversation instead of a queue, backed by a network that competes with anyone.

We're hiring! See the Jobs tab.

properties.name: LoadDelivered Logistics
properties.description:
LoadDelivered Logistics is a Chicago freight brokerage. We were founded in 2008 and joined Logistics Plus, a global logistics company, in 2025.

We move truckload, LTL, flatbed and heavy haul, and refrigerated freight across North America. Through Logistics Plus, our customers also reach air and ocean freight, warehousing, and customs brokerage, which means one team can handle a shipper's entire network rather than one lane of it.

Recognized by Transport Topics as a Top Freight Brokerage Firm by net revenue, by Food Logistics as a Top 3PL & Cold Storage Provider and a Top Software & Technology Provider, and named WK Kellogg's Broker of the Year. Based at 640 N LaSalle in River North. Small enough that a pricing decision is a conversation instead of a queue, backed by a network that competes with anyone.

We're hiring! See the Jobs tab.
